notes.title: Wow: The Kairos'Light Vanilla DLC works!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It's definitely not a good idea to launch a DLC without first testing it, and even more so on the day you leave for your vacation in Quebec. Life is full of surprises and twists.

However, taking advantage of a few hours whose driving rain ruled out the possibility of doing anything else with it, and with the gracious help of a comrade, the launch problems of the Kairos'Light Vanilla DLC have been resolved ːsteamthumbsupː

Here you can see the old trailer

[previewyoutube=LNf4FwoacnA;full][/previewyoutube]

Reminder:
This DLC has been released so that nostalgics and the curious can replay the first version of the Kairos'Light game. We've added a few new achievements for the occasion. The game, in its latest version, is "Kairos'Light" ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: DLC - Kairos'Light Vanilla
notes.notes:
[i][b]Foreword:[/b] If you have a problem launching the game with the DLC, try uninstalling and reinstalling the DLC. To do this, from your Steam library, right-click on "Kairos'Light" then "Properties" and do so from the "DLC" tab. 
We'll try to solve this little problem soon![/i]

Yo!
With this optional DLC, we're giving Kairos'Light fans the chance to rediscover the original version of the game, our first video game project, the one we cut our teeth on: [b]Kairos'Light Vanilla[/b].


[i]Rediscover the feeling of wandering through the city of Thésye, only less pretty and full of bugs! Enjoy Edmond's presence, but with a weird walking animation that makes him lame. Chat with the townspeople, and remember how untalented we are at writing dialogue. 
When you've done all that, [u]uninstall the DLC and go back to playing the current version on Steam[/u], like a nice hot bath after a long, tiring, cold hike.[/i]

All in all, “the Vanilla version of Kairos'Light is brilliant because of its harmonious blend of emotional storytelling, immersive gameplay mechanics, and charming aesthetics. These combined elements offer players a rich and memorable experience.” according to Chat GPT 3.5

[b]What more do you need to get started? Success ?[/b]
That's a good thing, because we've taken the opportunity to add several more! ... That is, if it works, because the old version's engine is no longer up to date, so we're not 100% sure it will!

[b]Have a great adventure![/b]

notes.title: Patch 02 - Kairos'Light Remake
notes.notes:
Hi! 

[b][u]Have you played Kairos'Light REMAKE? The question is quickly answered: No! Why? Because we didn't do any communication, we were lazy :D 
So as a reminder, here is the trailer of the remake ![/u][/b]

[previewyoutube=kYimDNBUZAo;full][/previewyoutube]

Today, we made a nice update mainly composed of improvements you asked us for, and we took the opportunity to fix some minor bugs in the remake.
We explain you all that!

The improvements : 
- The most expected: you can now cook several recipes at once! If you want to empty all your inventory to prepare 15 big reblochon flowers at once, it's possible. And if you still don't know what a reblochon flower is, we invite you to play Kairos'Light just to discover this dish you won't be able to live without!
- in the time selection interfaces, you can now click on the bar where you want the cursor to go, you don't have to drag it from the place where it is
- added a light effect to better understand the "invest" button at the exit of the mini-game work
- for balancing reasons, it is no longer possible to go to the garden for less than 3 hours at a time

Bugs: 
- no more lag when adding items to the junk shop or kitchen
- fixed a display bug when losing the last item of a page
- readjustment of some sound levels

May Kairos watch over you!

notes.title: Kairos'Light remasteurisay, because why not.
notes.notes:
Hi, here is what's going to happen for the release of kairos Light Remasteurisay! 

Last line to release the game, the dev and the designer are "on fire", that means "en feu".  

[b]Coming early October : [/b]
- Release of the provisional V2, to test and give us feedbacks. Most of the new graphics and mechanics will be there as well as the new achievements, but there will be more improvements to come in the following weeks. If you feel like a pioneer of this V2, don't hesitate (and come share bugs and epics moments on the discord if you want!). The endings won't be updated yet and are coming soon. 

- Even though our work is more like a new game / huge DLC, we decided to keep the page of the old Kairos'Light and release the remake of Kairos'Light as a major update. Later on, we will re-release the Vanilla version for the nostalgic ones as a separate game.

- We’ll be present on October 1st and 2nd at the Montpellier Stream Show, it takes place in Toulouse. No, in Montpellier, come on, you don't follow anything. We will have a booth with steam keys to reduce your future purchase of the game by 99%! Come and see us ! 

- And before that... the new trailer, with an animation created by Noémie, the super intern who helped all summer long ! 

[previewyoutube=kYimDNBUZAo;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Manage your Body Style
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! A little more information about our remake, especially about the clothes.

In the Vanilla version, the clothes were very expensive, and useless in terms of gameplay, which didn't make you want to enjoy them. So we decided to make several changes!

- the outfits now give [b]in-game bonuses [/b]! for example, the costume allows you to earn more money, the gardener outfit allows you to have more vegetables, etc...
- 12 new outfits composed of a pair of clothes (top and bottom)
- the outfits can be equipped only if you have the two "fragments" of clothes
- the closet in the room allows to access the interface of change of clothes
- the outfits can be obtained by several means: purchase at the style+, trade, search (garbage cans, recycling center), given by pnj, ...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37185322/3a41b146d18583d327df675fb8058c64c3844b65.png[/img]

We are also adding [b]new accessories[/b] which will also have their unique bonuses. In addition to an outfit, you can equip 1 accessory.
For example: the detective's moustache unlocks additional dialogue options. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37185322/5bd61711521b901a071f4c7765dec38999ac4e84.png[/img]

notes.title: New activity: gardener!
notes.notes:
Gardening is developed with a new mini game dedicated to garden management 🌱🐔.

Contents:
- A two-phase mini-game on the same operation as working at Oil Marketing Manager.
- Planting phase: choose the seeds you want to plant and embellish your garden with unlockable items (projects and skills) that will boost your crops.
- Harvesting phase: take care of your little plants by giving them water when they need it, repelling slugs, and don't forget to harvest the fruits of your labor.
- Choose not to harvest certain vegetables to recover their seeds and replant them the next time!

See you soon :D


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37185322/888bb680a2b06bb00090218363d338fdda07538c.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch 05: Improved game clarity & Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hi! We hope everyone's in good shape! A little update to fix some of the bugs you found. We've also fixed an important bug that was probably preventing English speaking players from progressing in the game. Below is the list of corrections!

Bugs : 
- When you clicked at the same time on the living room door leading to the world map and on a letter, you could encounter a bug (display "text" on the letter and then switch to the world map), it's solved
- Going to the TV interface and closing it (without watching TV) made you win XP for free... you can't cheat anymore!
- Swann's text on blackfriday day was cut, we've rectified that.
- You might have gotten out of the casino's mini wheel game and couldn't do anything about it, that's solved.
- The quest "miss 10 dishes" didn't come true when you made several dishes too quickly: you can now be as fast as lightning, your missed dishes will count well
- The "owning 50 cans" success story wasn't working.
- In English language only, bug when the magician returns (table problem). Thanks a lot to Mamo.ca on Steam who helped us solve it!

Readability/comprehension :
- Easter Eggs quests not intuitive enough → modified drawing
- Added the escape key to exit the options menu.
- Added feedback in Hubert's quest mini-game
- Added a line of explanation in the cleaning mini-game
- Adding a visual indication in the oven of recipes for which the player has all the ingredients available

Balancing : 
- Slight change in thresholds between the different purposes
- Reading energizes
- Watching TV now has a slight impact on your electricity bill

notes.title: Patch 04 - Kairos'Light in English
notes.notes:
After many requests, we decided to allow our English speaking friends to enjoy our game!
However, while waiting for a real professional translation, we did our best to translate the game ourselves. 
There are more than 250,000 characters of text, and the game was not designed for a second language. It was not easy.

You can meet us here:
- untranslated texts
- mistakes or sentences that don't mean anything (the game is full of French expressions and we play with words, so it's not easy to translate for tourists like us!).
- it is possible that bugs have been created.

Thank you for being tolerant, it's a free game and we really do our best to let you discover it!
We wish you a great game experience!

notes.title: Patch 02 - Clarty & Options & Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hi!

You've given us some new feedback in the community hub and in your opinions, especially the lack of readability and support during the first part as well as some bugs. So we've corrected a few points to improve the game in function!

b]Clarty of the game:[/b]
- Add a MAP by pressing the M button. Useful at first to find your apartment, it will update when you unlock some new projects.
- Adding a back button to exit the options menu

b]Adding features: [/b]
- Add in the options of the choice of the arrow keys: ZQSD or WASD
- You can now leave the quest book with the escape key.

[b] Bug fixes: [/b]
- Unblocking certain purposes automatically unblocked other purposes not voluntarily, this is corrected.
- Saving over an already finished game was causing a bug, you must now choose to delete your game before you can reuse the slot.
- During the tutorial, pressing escape when you were in an interface closed the interface (that's ok...) and opened the menu (that's not so ok !), it's fixed.
- Modification of the endgame credits image (it wasn't nice + MAJOR modification: we put a capital "m" to Jean-Marc)
- Added a timer before being able to skip the start kinematics to allow the game to load properly
- You were losing hits (in our game, not in Steam) when you loaded an old backup, it's resolved


If you find any other bugs, don't hesitate to let us know!

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

notes.title: Patch 01 - Overlay & Bug Fix & Difficulty
notes.notes:
Hello! 

You were able to accompany us in the game release and report several minor bugs. 
We fixed most of them! 

Also, the Steam overlay should work, allowing you to take screenshots and add them to the community :D 

Have a nice day! 
Below, the description of the changes:

[b][u]Patch 01 - Overlay & Bug Fix & Difficulty[/u][/b]

[b]Steam: [/b]

- Overlay access restored! You can now take screenshots and share them in the community!

[b]Difficulty & understanding: [/b]

- The first employee in the "Pognon Supervision" mini-game now has a fixed, rather than random, productivity, which should make the beginning of the game much less chaotic.
- Increase the chances of getting a recipe by reading
- Added info about double-clicking to save

[b]Tutorial:[/b]

- The menu is deactivated during the tutorial to avoid blockages.
- Access to the quest logbook is disabled during a reward interface to avoid blockages.
- The door of the department store reactivates after buying the bed (the bug was caused by the use of the quest book in the department store)
- Tutorial quests are well removed from the quest book if you pass it
- Arrows in the tutorial to indicate the exit from the house and to indicate the tab of the quest book replaced
- The menu is no longer available in the tutorial, in order to avoid problems.

[b]Other bugs:[/b]

- Modification of a quest text (small typo corrected)
- Modification of a discovery text of the apartment in the tutorial (small corrected typo)
- The sound of the money reward after working is no longer repeated indefinitely.
- Money correctly scrolls through the reward interface when returning from work
- Changing the time of appearance of the casino letter

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

notes.title: Kairos'Light is available!
notes.notes:
Kairos'Light is available!

Download the game and travel in the city of Thésye! 
Be ready to take care of Edmond, he's our darling and he merits all of your attention :D 

PS : IF you find a bug, don't hesitate to report it by mail : letsdevelopchange@gmail.com
If you are blocked because of a bug, and you really don't have any other solution, you can try to use the F1 key to unblock yourself (otherwise, don't use this key, it might block you!).

All the Kairos'Light company wishes you a pleasant trip to the city of Thésye ... :D

notes.title: Kairos'Light, scheduled the 29 May !
notes.notes:
Welcome !

Kairos'Light is soon ready to be released on Steam, and we look forward to seeing you on May 29th to discover the city of Thésye, its inhabitants, and all the content we have been creating for more than two years now in self-learning!

Kairos'Light has been developed by a team of passionate people who originally knew nothing about it! We learned how to draw, code, organize work, compose music, and much more...

We hope you'll enjoy the game! Until then, don't hesitate to wishlist the game to be informed of its release.
